evals.prompt: Where are we? I am returning to this project after two weeks away. Use the four-line status format only, no preamble or closing note.
evals.expected_output: Exactly four lines: What it is, Where it stands, Half-done, Next. The half-done line names the in-progress file and the unchecked box; Next copies the first item of the project's Next list.
expectations: The reply prints exactly the four labels What it is, Where it stands, Half-done and Next.
Half-done names the in-progress file and the unchecked task.
Next copies the first item from docs/PROJECT.md.

evals.prompt: Where are we? This repository has no docs/PROJECT.md.
evals.expected_output: The reply stops and says to run bootstrap-project. It does not create the state file or fall back to reading the whole repo.
expectations: The reply names bootstrap-project as the next step.
The reply does not create docs/PROJECT.md.
The reply does not read the whole repository instead.
